@sketch
Feature: Precise input

  @needs_fixture @capture_only
  Scenario: precise-input-06 Inspect and switch reference modes
    Given Point is active in an editable sketch
    And the reference triad is at the origin
    When the user open Precise Input and its reference-mode dropdown
    Then Relative and Absolute are listed
    When the user select Absolute
    Then its icon is displayed in the toolbar
    When the user enter X 5 and Y 6 and press Return
    Then a point marker appears and the coordinate fields reset for repeat entry
    When the user select Relative and enter the same pair and press Return
    Then no validation dialog appears and no distinct offset marker is visible
    And the origin triad remains at its prior visible position
    When the user restore Absolute and press Escape
    Then Point and Precise Input close and Ready reports 35 dimensions needed

  @needs_fixture @capture_only
  Scenario: precise-input-07 Measure the retained reference-mode trial marker
    Given the point marker from the paired input trial remains visible
    When the user open Measure and select that marker
    Then it is identified as Selection 1 Point
    And its global position is X 5.000 Y 0.500 Z -6.000 mm
    When the user click Done
    Then Measure closes and the marker remains

  @needs_fixture @point @capture_only
  Scenario: precise-input-01 Create a point with X and Y input
    Given Point is active in an editable sketch
    When the user open Precise Input in X and Y coordinate mode
    And the user focus X, press 5, press Tab, press 6, and press Return
    And the user press Escape and measure the created point
    Then its global position is X=0.000 mm, Y=5.000 mm, Z=6.000 mm in the specified sketch-plane fixture


  @invalid @needs_fixture
  Scenario: precise-input-03 Reject an alphabetic coordinate
    Given X and Y coordinate mode is active with numeric fields
    When the user focus X, select its value, and enter the single character a
    Then a is displayed in Red
    When the user press Return
    Then the Red value remains and no visible point is committed
    When the user press Escape and restart Point
    Then Precise Input reopens with numeric fields

  @mode @needs_fixture @capture_only
  Scenario: precise-input-04 Measure points created with coordinate modes
    Given Precise Input is in X and Y coordinate mode
    When the user open the coordinate-mode dropdown
    Then it offers X and Y coordinate
    And it offers X coordinate and X axis angle
    And it offers Y coordinate and X axis angle
    And it offers Distance and X axis angle
    When the user create a point in each mode using the original triad and the following inputs
    And the user measure each point in the specified sketch-plane fixture
    Then Measure reports these global positions to 0.001 mm
    | mode                              | first value | second value | global X | global Y | global Z |
    | X and Y coordinate                | 5           | 6            | 0.000    | 5.000    | 6.000    |
    | Distance and X axis angle         | 10          | 45 degrees   | 0.000    | 7.071    | 7.071    |
    | X coordinate and X axis angle     | 8           | 30 degrees   | 0.000    | 8.000    | 4.619    |
    | Y coordinate and X axis angle     | 8           | 60 degrees   | 0.000    | 4.619    | 8.000    |

  @needs_fixture @undo_redo
  Scenario: precise-input-05 Undo and redo a committed point
    Given a point committed through Precise Input
    When the user exit Point and undo and redo
    Then the point marker disappears and returns

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: precise-input-08 Relocate reset and close the triad toolbar
    Given Point and Precise Input are active in an editable sketch
    When the user activate Reposition Triad
    And click the displayed origin then the isolated line endpoint
    Then the triad visibly moves to that endpoint
    And Select center point is restored
    When the user choose Reset to Origin
    Then the triad returns to its prior origin position
    When the user open toolbar options
    Then Pin Mini-Toolbar Position, Auto Fade and Close are listed
    When the user choose Close
    Then the toolbar and triad disappear while Point remains active
    When the user press Escape
    Then Point ends and Ready is displayed
